user.title: Acond Heat Pump Setup
user.description: Enter the IP address of your heat pump and select the series.

data_description.host: IP address of the heat pump on your network (e.g. 192.168.1.100)
data_description.hp_series:
Grandis / Economis = compressor speed (rpm)
PRO = compressor power (W)

init.title: Acond integration settings
init.description:
Here you can edit the heat pump IP address, the maximum DHW temperature, and the compressor slider range. After saving, the integration reloads automatically and new values take effect immediately in the dashboard.

Heat pump series cannot be edited – changing it requires a reinstall.

data_description.host: New IP address of the heat pump on your network (e.g. 192.168.1.100)
data_description.tuv_max_temp: Range 50–60 °C. Default 50 °C (Acond accepts this without any service unlock). Values 51–60 require service-unlocked heat pump.
data_description.comp_capacity_min: Lowest value selectable on the compressor max speed/power slider (40014). Can be narrowed for safety or widened for service-unlocked range.
data_description.comp_capacity_max: Highest value selectable on the compressor max speed/power slider (40014).

error.comp_min_ge_max: Compressor minimum must be lower than maximum
